cases.input: A SaaS product is offered monthly in one market and annually in another.
cases.expect: One Product is referenced by distinct scoped Offering and Price Plan versions.

cases.input: A device and support service are sold as a temporary bundle.
cases.expect: The bundle is Offering composition unless separately governed as a durable Product.

cases.input: An internal channel offers a product under an explicit no-charge policy.
cases.expect: Availability is represented without missing-price ambiguity.
